status: Exploratory checks after original test outcomes were known; no source files or main manuscript modified
cv_selection_criterion: pooled out-of-fold spending MSE, separately by training treatment arm; no validation/test outcomes in selection
interaction_definition: (men's minus women's version in men's-only history) minus (men's minus women's version in women's-only history)

bootstrap.fixed: history-based audience and all message rules

limitations: Pointwise exploratory intervals; no multiplicity adjustment
No independent new campaign; original test outcomes previously examined
CV criterion is spending prediction, not policy revenue
Matching compares message versions within a common historical-spending audience
No profits, customer gender, send-time experiment, or isolated message-component effects
